snippet.title: NoiseFit Voyage | How to's & unboxing
snippet.description:
Here's India's 1st homegrown e-sim 4G calling smartwatch, NoiseFit Voyage.
It comes with a 1.4" Retina Amoled display, inbuilt GPS and Glonass for perfect navigation on our app.

Few of the class apart features :

1. E-sim supported 4G calling
2. Can connect any TWS with the smartwatch
3. Comes with a heart rate sensor, SPO2 sensor, pedometer,etc.
4. Automatic sensors for automatic detection of heart rate, SPO2, sleep data with analytics.
5. Upto 30 days of battery life on power saving mode.
6. IP68 water rating

How to setup and use e-sim with NoiseFit Voyage smartwatch.

Few important points to remember before setting up the e-sim.

1. Separate number is required to configure on to the e-sim.
2. Smartphones with e-sim support are required to configure the e-sim on the NoiseFit Voyage.

The setup :

1. Go to Playstore or app store and download NoiseFit Voyage app.
2. Download the app and pair the watch with the app.
3. Go to my device on the app and click on Manage eSim.
4. Select your network operator - Reliance Jio or Airtel.

For Airtel eSim users :

A. Using the Airtel thanks app

1. Download the Airtel thanks app.
2. Insert the new or existing sim in the phone that has eSim support.
3. Copy the EID number from the NoiseFit Voyage app.
4. Open the airtel thanks app - upgrade to eSim - Get eSim for another device - paste the EID number - Click on Get OTP - Continue.
5. Go back to the NoiseFit Voyage app and click on the Activate button available under the EID number and wait for the eSim to be downloaded on the watch.

It may take a minute for the whole setup.

B. Visiting the official Airtel store

1. Visit the store and ask for a new eSim number.
